correctness.rationale: An explicit graph-distance proof identifies every face. Attaching each full part simplex to the connected join along its isolated part vertices is a cellular homotopy pushout and adds exactly \(a_i-1\) circles. Repeated joins of discrete sets give \(\prod_i(a_i-1)\) spheres in degree t-1 (or a cone for singleton part). The natural integral LES of the pair gives the first and top homology modules and signed top-factor action for \(t\ge3\). Ten independent brute-force face checks, exact mod-two ranks, and signed Lefschetz traces corroborate, but do not substitute for, the infinite proof. No remaining unproved step in the stated scope was identified.

value.rationale: This is a natural and complete all-parameter topological classification of the geodesic general-position complexes underlying a current counting-polynomial study. It determines the nontrivial fundamental group, higher-dimensional sphere multiplicities, torsion-freeness, and canonical integral symmetry modules, including sign under part exchange. Mixed one-dimensional and arbitrarily high-dimensional homology occur together when \(t\ge3\) and all part sizes exceed one. These invariants are not supplied by the prior f-polynomial alone. The argument is elementary structurally, but the family-wide homotopy and equivariant lattice classification is substantive; no downstream result or broad theory is alleged.
